name: quoridor-engine
description: Quoridor engine workbench: canonical rules, versioned engines, arena, perft and tuning tools. No Mongo/Redis/Socket.IO.

scripts.perft:assert: node tools/perft.js --depth 3 --assert && node tools/perft.js --pawns --depth 7 --assert && node tools/perft.js --rules ./rules/reference.js --depth 3 --assert
scripts.match: node arena/src/cli.js match --adapter ./arena/adapters/quoridor.js --bots ./arena/bots.json --a v0-hard --b v0-medium --games 2000 --nodes 10000 --sprt 0,5 --threads 4 --out arena/results/v0-hard-vs-v0-medium.jsonl
scripts.arena:selftest: node arena/src/cli.js match --adapter ./arena/adapters/toy.js --bots ./arena/bots.toy.json --a smart --b random --games 200 --threads 2 --sprt 0,20 --out arena/results/selftest.jsonl
